summary: V6.25.44 bug-fix batch backend regression: ran 6 new tests covering Bug C (reference library member_ids fix), Bug D (adhoc_location_label on scenes + voice_lines channel-or-thread route wiring), and Bug B (canonical character edit route presence-check) plus 25 prior regression tests (V6.25.41 auto-queue, V6.25.42 e2e live, V6.25.43 scenes). 31/31 passed. Bug A is frontend-only (z-index on EncountersLibrary section) — verified source-only since spec said PRESENCE-check only.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/reference_editor.py L327-330: member_ids fix is correct; recommend also indexing `campaigns.member_ids` if not already, as this OR-query will table-scan for users on many campaigns.
routes/scenes.py create_scene: adhoc_location_label is silently truncated to 200 chars without warning — acceptable but should be documented in API response or returned as a flag.

routes/voice_lines.py L203-219: channel-or-thread lookup falls back gracefully but does TWO sequential db lookups per voice-line upload; could be merged to one $or query for a small perf win on the hot PTT path.
voice_lines.py L98-100: `await db.campaigns.find_one(...).get('gm_id')` — pattern is repeated; that campaign lookup was already done in `_seated_or_403`. Refactor candidate to avoid the double-fetch.

scenes.py L411-420: `attach_message_to_scene` has dead code path — if both `message_id` and `voice_line_id` are passed, the early `await db.scenes.update_one` runs then `upd = {}` clears the rest, losing the participant_character_ids $addToSet. Voice-line upload bypasses this helper (does its own update), so this only bites callers that pass both. Tracked for cleanup.
